posts.title: 24K Gold, Lavender Pearls, and inked custom materials in your 3D plots
posts.description: Blender, ZBrush, SculptGL, or other programs are the way to go if you want to create sophisticated 3D figures for a presentation, paper, or blog post. However, if you already generate your shapes programmatically or derive them from external data sources, it is convenient to render them using the same set of tools.

posts.title: Coding Pong from Scratch ● Live Stream Transcription
posts.description: A hands-on guide to building the classic Pong game in Wolfram Language. Originally recorded as a live session on October 29, it was later adapted into this blog post. It covers ball physics, Verlet integration, collisions, paddle controls, sound effects, scoring, momentum transfer, and a CPU opponent.

posts.title: From a Photo to a Scanned Document
posts.description: Let’s make something practical. You have a bunch of document photos, and you want to make them look like scans - ideally in a batch. Why use online services when your fellow Wolfram/WLJS can do the job?
